# Costfluent Provider

Terraform provider for managing Costfluent cloud cost management resources. The guide to the provider and the cost-access modules is https://docs.costfluent.com/developers/terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    costfluent = {
      source  = "costfluent/costfluent"
      version = "~> 0.3.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "costfluent" {
  # api_key = var.costfluent_api_key  # Or set COSTFLUENT_API_KEY
  # workspace = "wsp_default"        # Optional default workspace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Costfluent API key. An organization token (cf_org_) reaches every workspace and the organization-level resources; a workspace token (cf_ws_) reaches only its workspace, so list data sources return that workspace alone and organization-level resources need an organization token. The provider reads the token when it is configured and stops on one Costfluent refuses, and each resource checks at plan that the token carries the capabilities its change needs, so nothing is changed with a token that would be refused part way. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Costfluent API base URL, https except on localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_BASE_URL environment variable. Defaults to https://api.costfluent.com
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout of each request attempt in seconds, at least 1. Defaults to 30.
- `workspace` (String) Default workspace ID (wsp_...) for workspace-scoped resources. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_WORKSPACE environment variable.
